biotools.summary: BARtab and bartools are a suite of tools designed for the analysis of cellular barcoding datasets from population-level, single-cell, and spatial transcriptomics experiments. The tools streamline data extraction, quality control, analysis, and visualization, offering a comprehensive workflow for lineage tracing.
